verdict.rationale: Missive documents assigning conversations to a team or a specific person, and a rules and automations engine whose steps check conditions and act on conversations, including reassignment, so ownership can be made explicit. The evidence is mostly marketing and changelog snippets, though. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of rule-based routing of incoming mail (e.g., sender/subject conditions assigning on arrival), load-balancing assignment, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-lead, I can assign conversations to teammates and route incoming mail with rules so ownership is explicit

citations.quote: Assign conversations to a team or specific person, while maintaining visibility.
Rules can now run in steps over time. Each step waits, checks its own conditions, then acts on the same conversation.
Escalate unanswered support emails: label at 24 hrs, notify the lead at 48, reassign at 72.
